M00.name: handle_action
M00.inputs: Action, payload, repository, supported_rules, clock, id_factory
M00.contract: Dispatch maintenance, calculation, history or export. During calculation call S2 then S3 then S4 then S5 then S6; stop at the first error and convert its issues through M26 before publishing rejection.

M10.name: maintain_sources
M10.contract: Read current revision; parse, merge and validate one submission; commit only a fully accepted candidate.

M11.name: parse_submission
M11.contract: Parse required fields without rounding, preserve row locations, reject duplicate input keys and unknown columns where policy requires.

M12.name: merge_source_patch
M12.contract: Apply explicit upserts to a copy. Stock upserts identify both snapshot date and material. No implicit deletion or mutation of the original.

M13.name: validate_source_edit
M13.contract: Check uniqueness, referenced IDs, integer/date domains and stock bounds. Detect incompatible BUY edges and cycles in changed BOM; full selected MAKE completeness is checked in S2.

M14.name: commit_source_revision
M14.contract: In one transaction create an immutable revision, compare the current revision, move the head, and commit; conflicts and failures roll back.

M15.name: make_maintenance_response
M15.contract: REJECTED has zero accepted records. On commit failure do not report accepted data.

M20.name: prepare_context
M20.contract: Obtain one consistent snapshot, validate selected data and BOM, order tasks and freeze a read-only context. Return READY with prepared input, or call M26 and return INVALID with that outcome.

M21.name: read_source_snapshot
M21.contract: Read source head and all required revision rows in one read transaction. Null date is used for maintenance reads; planning selects the baseline stock snapshot.

M22.name: validate_selected_data
M22.contract: Reject no selection, duplicate or unknown task IDs, unsupported rules, invalid fields and missing reachable stock. Snapshot date must equal baseline.

M23.name: validate_and_index_bom
M23.contract: Validate all selected reachable edges including stock-covered branches; return adjacency and deterministic parent-before-child order or located graph errors.

M24.name: order_tasks
M24.contract: Sort by priority ascending, due date ascending, then ordinal task ID. Preserve no import-row tie-break.

M25.name: freeze_context
M25.contract: Copy validated inputs and initial availability into E1 Context; attach only a derived graph index outside the retained E1 Context.

M26.name: make_invalid_outcome
M26.contract: Return INVALID with null result and blocking issues. Do not manufacture an empty successful batch.

M30.name: net_requirements
M30.contract: Own the batch balance map. Complete each task before the next; visit materials in parent-before-child order, then dates ascending.

M31.name: initialize_balances
M31.contract: Create available quantities as on_hand minus reserved exactly once per run.

M32.name: collect_material_demands
M32.contract: For this task/material collect all contributions, group by date, preserve origins and return dates ascending. The caller must first finish all parents.

M33.name: allocate_stock
M33.contract: Allocate min(balance,gross). Split origin attribution by ordinal BOM path then origin ID. Return residual, ledger and new balance; do not mutate caller inputs.

M34.name: expand_make_demand
M34.contract: For positive MAKE net quantity derive start date, one MAKE row and children from attributed net origins. Zero net yields no MAKE row or children. Calls M52.

M35.name: record_buy_shortage
M35.contract: Return a positive BUY residual with date/source links; otherwise return null.

M36.name: assemble_net_bundle
M36.inputs: Context, netted_demands, allocations, make_lines, shortages, final_balances
M36.contract: Check gross=allocated+net, origin totals, stock conservation and reference integrity before returning the completed bundle.

M40.name: plan_purchases
M40.contract: Use only BUY residuals after existing-stock allocation completes; iterate material IDs and needed dates with one separate surplus pool per material.

M41.name: group_buy_shortages
M41.contract: Group by material and needed date across tasks; preserve shortage IDs. Sort material ID ordinal, then date.

M42.name: consume_surplus
M42.contract: Consume only lots available by the needed date, earliest arrival then supply bucket ID. Return remaining gap, updated lots and source-use links.

M43.name: round_purchase_qty
M43.contract: Zero gap returns zero even with a positive minimum. Otherwise use exact integer ceiling of max(gap,minimum) to the multiple.

M44.name: finalize_purchase_bucket
M44.contract: Build the dated bucket and update the returned pool with new rounding excess; no order date for zero purchase. Calls M52 only for positive purchases.

M45.name: assemble_purchase_envelope
M45.contract: Check quantity/date conservation and produce the complete purchasing result, retaining zero-purchase buckets for trace.

M50.name: complete_plan
M50.contract: Collect required events, assess dates against baseline, assemble totals and return VALID with the calculated result.

M51.name: collect_required_dates
M51.contract: Include every selected task due date and positive manufacturing/purchase start; retain event/task/material links. Ignore nonexistent zero-quantity orders.

M52.name: subtract_calendar_days
M52.contract: Subtract calendar days including weekends and leap days. Zero is valid; return DATE_RANGE if the result cannot be represented.

M53.name: flag_early_dates
M53.contract: Only dates strictly before baseline are RISK; retain original date and positive difference in calendar days.

M54.name: assemble_calculated_batch
M54.contract: Attach net bundle, procurement, surplus uses, risks and count summary. Do not add quantities across unrelated units.

M60.name: publish_results
M60.contract: For VALID outcome save first, then expose saved data; INVALID becomes rejection. For queries load saved history, build views and optionally CSV.

M61.name: classify_outcome
M61.contract: Pass a valid complete result or return its blocking issues; enforce the tagged union.

M62.name: save_batch_atomic
M62.contract: Insert one canonical result document including all snapshots in a transaction. Return SAVED only after commit.

M63.name: read_history
M63.contract: Read exact saved documents; return NOT_FOUND for missing detail/export batches; listing may return an empty list.

M64.name: build_trace_view
M64.contract: Filter display rows while retaining their linked source, demand, allocation and supply records. Never consult current source data.

M65.name: encode_csv
M65.contract: UTF-8 CSV with a header, proper quoting and ISO dates. Export MAKE, PURCHASE, ALLOCATION, TRACE or RISK; preserve batch identifiers.

M66.name: make_plan_response
M66.inputs: request_id, outcome_status, saved_records, view, csv, issues
M66.contract: Map failures and successes consistently. A failed save returns SAVE_FAILED with no successful saved records.
